round: 3: shared Q/K-normalized model, isolated SSMax score strength

short_evidence.interpretation: The short ablation changes both magnitude sensitivity and attention-score scale. Its speed advantage does not identify the cause. Test softer normalized attention while retaining uniform projection-independent score control.

single_change: Multiply the existing SSMax attention gain by a fixed scalar m=1/2 or m=1/4 after Q/K RMS. This is effective SSMax s=m, not the previous parameter-free s=1 default.
equation: scores_ij = m * log(i+1) * g_h * dot(R_i RMS(q_i), R_j RMS(k_j)), j<=i. All cached positions use full visible key count.
invariants: Keep Q/K RMS, scaled Peri-RMS, embedding RMS, centered XSA, SwiGLU, ordinary fixed RoPE, tied weights, parameter-free normalization, all original tensors/RNG, LR x2, AdamW settings, data, model dimensions, batch order, cadence, thresholds and original update budgets.
scope: No LeRoPE or activation/residual/numerical-repair changes are combined with this score-only trial. Their prior positive and negative results remain retained.
guarantee: With epsilon>0, width d>0, N>=1 and m>=0, abs(score)<=m*log(N)*abs(g_h)*d independently of Q/K projection-weight norms. For m<=1 this is no larger than the parent bound. It is not a margin, whole-network Jacobian, learning or floating-point guarantee.
screen_policy: Require 18/18 passes and improved median paired epochs in at least 3 of the 6 tasks versus the Q/K-normalized parent. Keep every row, miss and error. No screen geometric mean. This parent-control gate is declared before new training, distinct from round 2 LR x2 gating.
full_policy: Run all 75 short cells for each arm passing its screen. Select a new shared-model winner only with full coverage and a lower all-75 geometric mean than the Q/K parent. Retain the parent if no arm improves. Compare every eligible arm with baseline, LR x2, parent and the measured no-QK ablation; keep their separate overall and shared-model rankings.
long_policy: After all promoted short suites, freeze the shared-model choice. If a new shared-model winner is selected, run it once on the reused 30-cell diagnostic at original budgets. Never use long outcomes to choose scales, screen tasks, candidates, thresholds or subsequent tuning.
stress_policy: Before benchmark training, verify initialization/capacity/RNG, independent forward and gradients, singleton and causal/dense/chunked/shared caches, Q/K magnitude and context-length score bounds, and native CUDA graph capture/update equivalence. Preserve failures rather than claim universal stability.
source_policy: All previous scientific Python and plans remain unchanged. New source, configs, plan and hashes are archived independently; reuse the existing training loop and scorer with explicit factories.
not_used_for_design: Completed long diagnostic outcomes. The score-strength hypothesis and Q/K retention are based on short evidence, mathematical control and the user direction.

score_stress.scope: One normalized SSMax row in FP32 versus the same finite-epsilon equation in FP64; existing full-stack extreme failures are not erased by reducing scores.
